offset.description: Steering center offset in degrees; positive biases right, negative biases left.

left_limit_angle.description: Maximum left steering angle in degrees.

right_limit_angle.description: Maximum right steering angle in degrees.

center_angle.description: Servo angle in degrees that corresponds to centred steering.

centering_speed.description: Speed in degrees per second used when centring the steering.

turning_speed.description: Default speed used when moving the steering to a commanded position.

reversed.description: Invert steering direction when left commands otherwise turn the wheels right.
Invert the drive direction when forward commands otherwise move the robot backward.

encoder_reversed.description: Whether the encoder counts up when the robot moves backward; independent of drive.reversed.

min_speed.description: Lowest drive motor speed command that operates effectively.

max_speed.description: Highest drive motor speed command considered safe.

speed_scale.description: Velocity to motor-speed scale factor: motor_speed = velocity_m_s * speed_scale.

default_speed.description: Fallback drive motor speed command when none is specified.

test_duration.description: Duration in seconds for motor test/diagnostic runs.
